items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I was the only woman, though, with Snub Mosely... With 17 men... Snub Mosely and all of them were working with their hats and their gloves and things on.

ctx.x: Snub Mosely, I know, at one point.
Well, Snub Mosely was the last one. I was the only woman, though, with Snub Mosely.
